question: When did the government launch Start-up India Seed Fund Scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government launched the **Start-up India Seed Fund Scheme** in the year **2021**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization.
 
• It is part of the larger **Start-up India initiative**, which was launched in **January 2016** to build a strong ecosystem for nurturing innovation and startups in the country.
 
• The scheme is expected to support an estimated **3,600 startups through 300 incubators** over the next four years.
 
• It is designed to promote the growth of startups in sectors such as manufacturing, agriculture, healthcare, and technology, among others.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Start-up India initiative has been instrumental in fostering a culture of entrepreneurship and innovation in India.
 
• Since its inception, the initiative has resulted in numerous policy measures and reforms aimed at simplifying the regulatory environment for startups.
 
• The initiative also includes benefits such as tax exemptions, easier compliance norms, and access to funding and mentorship opportunities.
 
• **Startups can register on the Start-up India portal** to avail of various benefits and resources offered under the initiative.
 
• The government continues to introduce new measures to support the startup ecosystem, recognizing its potential to drive economic growth and job creation.
